subject: sty
title: STY.------RT.INT.TR.
description: Chart on book p. 250 (CMBA-6). STY (style) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is the partner. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and VT-ATT (vibrational attitude). From AFL-DY: V-SY (value system) and POST (postulation). From POST: T-P (time presence) and RC (race). From RC: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From VT-ATT: PART (participation). From PART: TRS (transition).
